findings.reasoning: I read _startRepeatJob/_collectRepeatJobRow in full (38644-38802) but not past line 38808. What I did see shows the Repeat Finder's long job (chunked by setTimeout/_repeatNextTask, runPerSeq(..., seqs) with a status line, no busyOverlay) anchors every piece of data it keeps to the row OBJECT, not to a captured index: line 38756 re-resolves the row index live, per sequence, at collect time (line 38767 'seqIndex: row >= 0 ? row : t.index', 38772 'r.seqIndex = row >= 0 ? row : t.index', 38773 'r.obj = t.obj'), so if the user deleted or reordered rows while the run went on, indexOf(-1 -> t.index) and t.obj still track the same row.
